name: period-stepper
title: Period stepper
description: Step through days, weeks, months or years with previous, next and a Today shortcut. The label is announced as it changes, and the buttons switch off at your limits.
docs: unit is day, week (default), month or year. value is any day inside the period, written 2026-10-21; onChange receives the new period's first day and its { start, end, unit }. Days are calendar days, never moments, so nothing shifts with a time zone. min and max limit what can be shown: the buttons switch off at the period that holds the limit, and focus moves to the label so it is not lost. Today appears only when the period shown is not the current one and is within the limits. The label is a polite live region and a tab stop: with focus on it the left and right arrow keys step (reversed in right-to-left). Week labels read "Week 43, 19 to 25 Oct 2026" and day labels "Monday, 26 Oct 2026", both on two lines; weekStart 1 numbers by ISO, any other start counts the week holding 1 January as week 1. The control keeps the width of the widest label its unit can show in the language (a week across New Year, the longest month), so the buttons do not move as you step, and in a container too narrow for it the label shrinks and ends in an ellipsis. locale writes the label and timeZone decides what today is; a cached page must pass today or value. labels translates.
